overall_status: MATCH: the Heritage::collect end-address wraparound clamp (heritage.cc:317-320) now mirrors the locked 12.0.4 oracle byte-for-byte — when the wrapped end offset falls below the range start, the collect window end is endLoc(Address(space, getHighest())) (the next-space boundary, varnode.cc:1596-1602), i.e. the scan runs from start to the end of the range's space with no offset bound, instead of beginLoc(wrapped-end) which terminates the window immediately. All three cases (straddling 2-byte write at the space top with a 1-byte BOOL read, the byte-identical non-wrapping control at 0x206, and the exact-top 1-byte write/read pair) produce identical pass counters, op counts, BOOL-input link forms, free-with-reader censuses, globaldisjoint cover dumps, phi projections, op lists, and Varnode multisets on both sides. Production reachability note (registered at review): the branch needs a MemRange straddling the space top — a varnode at offset 0xffffffffffffffff with size > 1 entering the disjoint cover — which no real loader emits; the divergence was pre-existing, not r2-introduced, and is pinned structurally per the oracle regardless.
architecture: locked synthetic LE 64-bit Architecture: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5, join=6, iop=7; all spaces 8-byte addressable (register highest = 0xffffffffffffffff); register delay=0, stack delay=1
compiler_spec: synthetic prototype fixture: extrapop=0, empty input/output, no effect records, no symbols, high-level disabled

analysis_options.entrypoint: Direct invocation of the production boundary Funcdata::opHeritage (funcdata.hh:462) once per case on a fresh Funcdata; no Action tree, no C emission; the pass counter is read after the call (C++ getHeritagePass / Rust num_heritage_passes)
analysis_options.prestate: Per-case fresh Funcdata built through production APIs (newOp/opSetOpcode/opSetInput/opSetOutput/newUniqueOut/newConstant/newVarnode/opInsertEnd/newBlockBasic). Both sides apply the startProcessing steps a synthetic graph can reach: structureLoops+calcForwardDominator (Ghidra) mirrors as find_spanning_tree (BLOCK-INDEX-ASSIGN-0001) + BlockGraph::build_dom_tree, then heritage.buildInfoList (funcdata.cc:166). Each BOOL read is a fresh free Varnode with exactly one descendant, mirroring the PcodeEmitFd::dump single-descendant invariant (funcdata.cc:878-908); free reads are created AFTER the same-location write so the pair stays two objects (VarnodeBank::create reuses only free varnodes, varnode.cc:1250-1258)
analysis_options.observation: Per case: pass counter; live op count; bool_in (descriptor of the BOOL op's flag input after rename); free_with_reader (whole-bank census of free Varnodes with descendants — the varnode.cc:334-336 throw precondition); gd (persistent globaldisjoint cover dump over processor/stack spaces, name:hexoff:size:p<pass> — unique-space entries are allocation-dependent and excluded); phi projection; full op list in PcodeOpTree order as name.OPCODE(input descriptors); sorted Varnode descriptor multiset. The Rust comparand additionally asserts (abort on violation, no stdout) the clamp witnesses: the cover holds the case range at pass 0 with the expected size and the census is zero
analysis_options.normalization: No order, flag, list, or membership normalization; absolute unique-space offsets are not printed because allocation bases differ between the implementations; descriptors carry space class, offset or size, def-use class, and defining opcode; the cover dump re-sorts by the synthetic architecture's space index then offset to match the oracle's map<Address,SizePass> order

input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, and cases
cases: wraparound_straddling_write: single block b0 with w=INT_SUB(C2:0,C2:1) writing register 0xffffffffffffffff:2 (straddling the 8-byte space top) and n=BOOL_NEGATE(fresh free Rffffffffffffffff:1) with unique temp output plus c=CBRANCH(C8:2000, n_out); the disjoint cover range [0xffffffffffffffff,+2) wraps to end offset 1, the cc:317-320 clamp keeps both varnodes in the collect window, and after one opHeritage the BOOL input is the SUBPIECE output (normalizeReadSize cc:382-412, constant C8:0 per newConstant(addr.getAddrSize(),0)) reading the 2-byte write; census 0

nonwrap_control_same_shape: the byte-identical graph at register 0x206 (endaddr 0x208 does not wrap); identical window membership and the same SUBPIECE link form — the differential control proving the clamp preserves collect behavior rather than changing it; census 0

wraparound_exact_top: w=INT_SUB(C1:0,C1:1) writing register 0xffffffffffffffff:1 (endaddr wraps to 0 < start) with a same-size free read at the top byte; the clamp window contains both (inclusive top edge: endLoc(space,getHighest()) runs through offset == highest) and rename links the read directly to the write with no SUBPIECE; census 0

observation_schema.format: Four fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one envelope plus three case records
observation_schema.state: pass counter; live op count; BOOL input descriptor; free-with-reader census; globaldisjoint cover dump; phi projection; op list (PcodeOpTree order, name.OPCODE + per-slot input descriptors); sorted Varnode descriptor multiset
observation_schema.graph: def-use class and defining opcode per op input slot, Varnode space class, offset or size, def-use class and defining opcode multiset, cover range size and pass

coverage.wraparound_straddle_subpiece_link: MATCH: wraparound_straddling_write — endaddr wraps to 1 < start (2-byte range at the 8-byte space top), the clamp window keeps read+write, normalizeReadSize produces bool_in=Rffffffffffffffff:1:W+SUBPIECE with phi.SUBPIECE(Rffffffffffffffff:2:W+INT_SUB,C8:0); byte-identical projection
coverage.nonwrap_control_same_shape: MATCH: nonwrap_control_same_shape — the byte-identical graph at 0x206 (endaddr 0x208, no wrap) yields the same link form (R206:1:W+SUBPIECE, phi.SUBPIECE(R206:2:W+INT_SUB,C8:0)); proves the clamp preserves collect behavior (same shape modulo offset)
coverage.wraparound_exact_top_direct_link: MATCH: wraparound_exact_top — 1-byte range at the top byte (endaddr wraps to 0), inclusive top edge keeps both varnodes in the window, equal sizes link directly (bool_in=Rffffffffffffffff:1:W+INT_SUB, no SUBPIECE, ops=3)
coverage.globaldisjoint_cover_witness: MATCH: every case's persistent globaldisjoint cover holds the case range at pass 0 with the expected size (register:ffffffffffffffff:2:p0 / register:206:2:p0 / register:ffffffffffffffff:1:p0) on both sides — the wrapping ranges really entered the cover through the canonical cc:2708-2710 candidate scan
coverage.clamp_regression_power: MATCH (discriminating-power evidence, not an oracle comparison): reverting the Rust window end to the pre-fix single break (offset bound applied unconditionally) makes the Rust comparand abort in case A — the wrapped end offset terminates the window before any member, the free read stays free-with-descendant, and the silent census witness fires (exit 101, observed in the dry run); the branch is pinned, not decorative
